title: Handle-remap and material-root vector ownership transfers
scope: Avoid copying the completed source-to-emitted handle map at the dwg2dxf-to-dxfRW setup boundary.
Avoid copying the no-longer-needed material-root entry vector when seeding the final root dictionary list.
Preserve existing const-reference caller behavior and root dictionary handle resolution.

sourceChange.before: fileExport built a local std::map for fixed-collision remaps, copied it into dxfRW with setHandleRemap(const map&), then used the local map for later root-dictionary formatting. It also copied materialRootEntries into rootEntries even though the source vector was not used afterward.
sourceChange.after: An rvalue-reference overload moves the completed map into dxfRW. The four later root-dictionary lookups call the existing dxfRW::remapHandle resolver; the const-reference overload is unchanged. materialRootEntries is moved into rootEntries before final remapping and augmentation.
sourceChange.effect: Eliminates one deep copy of the completed mapping and one copy of the material-root string pairs while retaining the same collision allocation, mapping entries, root ordering, and output values.

build.command: cmake --build build-gcc --target dwg2dxf libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip -j2

focusedTests.coverage: Generated AC1027 multi-record AcDs projection in ASCII and Binary DXF.

validation.diffCheck: scoped git diff --check passed for src/libdxfrw.h, dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Avoids redundant copies of the handle map and material-root vector while keeping caller-facing copy semantics and using the codec's existing mapping resolver for the remaining pre-write consumers.

testsRun: Strict dwg2dxf, DXF fixture-test, adapter-test, and local-roundtrip target builds
Focused BLOCK_RECORD owner, dictionary, linetype, class, raw-section, modeler, and IMAGEDEF regressions
Generated AC1027 multi-record AcDs projection in ASCII/Binary DXF
method.limitations: No RSS or allocator instrumentation was run. The map and root entries remain necessary as codec-owned write state. The change does not qualify all handle-reference roles or semantic graph closure.
